description: This file defines views related to weather streaming API endpoints in a Django application. It includes a generator function for streaming weather updates in newline-delimited JSON (ndjson) format, along with two API view functions: one providing usage information and another establishing a streaming HTTP response for weather data.

methods.name: Iterable[bytes] _weather_stream_generator( city: Optional[str], units: str, delay_seconds: float = 0.35, )
methods.description: Internal generator yielding chunks of weather data in ndjson format, including headers, simulated updates, and trailer.

methods.name: Response mcp_weather_usage(request: HttpRequest)
methods.description: API view providing clients with usage instructions for the weather streaming endpoint.

methods.name: HttpResponse stream_weather(request: HttpRequest)
methods.description: API view that initiates a streaming HTTP response with simulated weather updates.

ctags.name: _weather_stream_generator
ctags.signature: ( city: Optional[str], units: str, delay_seconds: float = 0.35, )
